items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: shadcn's Button with a loading state: a spinner over the label, and the button keeps its width.

changes: A `loading` prop: the label stays in place but hidden, so the button keeps its width, with a spinner over it and `aria-busy` set.
A busy button doesn't fade the way a disabled one does.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: The copy button from shadcn's docs as an installable component: built on Button, with a fallback where the Clipboard API is blocked, icon-only or labeled, and its own confirmation for 2s.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: shadcn's Label, which dims with a disabled Field.

changes: Takes the theme's foreground color, and dims with a disabled Field.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: shadcn's Field, wired: the label, description, error and success messages connect to the control on their own, and invalid, disabled and required reach it from the Field.

changes: A Field wires its control: the label points at it, and it's described by whichever description, error or success message is actually rendered.
`invalid`, `disabled` and `required` on the Field reach the control; `required` adds a marker to the label.
FieldError carries an icon and renders nothing when empty, so it never leaves a gap; FieldValid is new.
FieldDescription is a div, so it can hold a list.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: shadcn's Input with sm, default and lg sizes to match the Button. Inside a Field it wires itself up.

changes: Sizes: `sm` (32px), `default` (36px) and `lg` (40px), matching the Button. A numeric `size` still sets the native attribute.
Inside a Field it picks up its id, description and state.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: shadcn's Textarea that grows with its content up to a limit, then scrolls. Inside a Field it wires itself up.

changes: Field wiring, and it stops growing at `max-h-64`, then scrolls.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: shadcn's InputGroup with the Input's sizes: icons, text and buttons inside one border.

changes: The Input's sizes on the group.
Clicking an addon focuses whichever control the group holds, a textarea included.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with a show/hide toggle that keeps the caret in place and a Caps Lock warning.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A whole-number field with the numeric keypad on phones, arrow-key and button steppers, and clamping on blur.

items.name: requirement-list
items.title: Requirement List
items.description: A field's rules, shown before the first keystroke and ticked off as each is met.

items.name: error-summary
items.title: Error Summary
items.description: The GOV.UK error summary: on a failed submit it takes focus, counts the problems and links each one to its field.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: shadcn's HoverCard that can load its content on intent: give it a load function and a cache key, and render the loading, loaded and error states.

changes: Opens after 120ms and closes after 100ms, tuned for previews, in place of Radix's 700/300.
Keyboard focus on the trigger opens it too.
`load` fetches the card's content the first time it opens, and `cacheKey` shares the result across cards for the session. A failed load retries on the next open.
HoverCardContent's children can be a function of the load state (`idle`, `loading`, `success`, `error`), and `useHoverCard()` reads it anywhere inside.
`onOpen` fires once, the first time the card opens.

items.name: timestamp
items.title: Timestamp
items.description: An instant in the viewer's timezone with the zone always visible; on intent, the same instant where it happened and in UTC.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: shadcn's Separator.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: shadcn's Skeleton: a placeholder sized to the content that's coming.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: shadcn's Spinner, for waits with no shape to hold.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: shadcn's Empty: what goes where there's nothing yet, nothing matching, or nothing left.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: shadcn's Kbd, for showing the key next to the action it triggers.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: shadcn's ButtonGroup: related actions in one row, which works as a toolbar.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: shadcn's Dialog: a modal that traps focus while open and hands it back when it closes.
